pages.title: Toimsa 16″ Vintage Bicycle - Beige
pages.description: Toimsa 16″ Vintage Bicycle - Beige. Perfect for kids aged 5-7, featuring a retro design, front and rear brakes, adjustable components, and a wicker-style basket. Clarkes of Cavan
pages.ld_description:
Retro Design: Classic beige color with a vintage look, complete with a front wicker-style basket.
	
Front and Rear Calliper Brakes: Ensures reliable stopping power for enhanced safety.
	
Pneumatic Tires: Offers a smooth ride with excellent grip on various surfaces.
	
Spoked Wheels with Chrome Mudguards: Durable and stylish, providing protection from splashes.
	
Adjustable Sprung Saddle and Handlebars: Customizable for growing children, ensuring comfort and proper fit.
	
Rear Carrier Rack: Practical for carrying school bags, groceries, or other essentials.
	
Removable Stabilisers: Helps young riders develop balance and confidence.
	
Full-Length Chainguard: Provides added safety by covering the chain completely.
